definitions.explanation: A practice session conducted before the actual event to ensure everything goes smoothly. Used for ceremonies, performances, military exercises, and other organized events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予行演習|よこうえんしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予行演習|よこうえんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We held a rehearsal for the graduation ceremony.

notes:
Compound of {予行|よこう} (preliminary run) and ⟦{演習|えんしゅう}→演習：13363_enshuu⟧ (exercise/drill). A formal word for a full practice run of an event, ensuring all participants know their roles and the sequence of events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予行演習|よこうえんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a rehearsal
- {予行演習|よこうえんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to do repeated rehearsals
- {予行演習|よこうえんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to participate in a rehearsal
- ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予行演習|よこうえんしゅう}: graduation ceremony rehearsal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リハーサル→リハーサル：07559_rihaasaru⟧: rehearsal — the loanword, used mainly for performances, concerts, and shows
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: practice — general term for practicing any skill; not specific to event run-throughs
- ⟦{模擬|もぎ}→模擬：19836_mogi⟧: mock, simulated — used as a prefix (⟦{模擬試験|もぎしけん}→模擬試験：18219_mogishiken⟧ = mock exam)

USAGE:
Very common in school contexts, especially for ceremonies like ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧ (entrance ceremony) and ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ (graduation ceremony). Also used for military drills and disaster preparedness exercises.
